text:
Noise, CMRR and PSRR all fail, and the sensitivities show they improve together with input-pair gm/Id and channel length. This edit enlarges the input pair, lengthens the bias family and recalibrates the noise and PSRR models.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Noise is flicker-dominated and CMRR/PSRR are limited by the tail and pair. Use a higher-gm/Id, longer input pair (bigger area, lower Vgs, more tail Vds). Lengthen the bias family to L=3 for tail resistance. Lower ccf to recover UGBW. Recalibrate the noise and PSRR models."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (23.0, 18.0, 26.0),     # diff pair gm/Id (weak inversion)
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # diff pair L (flicker area, CMRR)
    "itail": (8e-6, 6e-6, 10e-6),    # first-stage tail current
    "i7":    (18e-6, 14e-6, 19e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmid7": (12.0, 9.0, 15.0),      # second-stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.0),        # second-stage PMOS L
    "L3":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror-load L
    "ccf":   (0.95, 0.75, 1.3),      # Cc = gm1/(2*pi*28MHz) * ccf
    "rzf":   (1.0, 0.7, 1.5),        # Rz scale vs. p2-cancellation value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail, i7 = p["itail"], p["i7"]
    gmidb, Lb = 12.0, 3.0                      # NMOS bias mirror family (longer L -> higher rout)

    mb = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, itail, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, i7, vds=0.9)

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["L3"], itail / 2, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    ugbw_t = 28e6
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * ugbw_t) * p["ccf"]
    c1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + 5e-15
    c2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    rz = (1.0 + c2 / cc) / gm7 * p["rzf"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nc", rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", cc)

    # predictions
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc) * 0.85          # calibrated: sim ran ~5-15% below gm1/Cc
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    resid = gm7 / (2 * PI * c2) * 6.0
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * pmir)))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / resid))) + 8.0
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i7)
    slew = min(itail / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    settle = 0.6 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat + 0.1
    # flicker-dominated noise, calibrated on previous run (gm/Id 20, L 1, Id 4 uA -> 450 nV)
    mref = lut.size("n", 20.0, 1.0, 3.9e-6, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    noise_1k = 4.5e-7 * math.sqrt((mref.W * mref.L) / (m1.W * m1.L))
    gm3 = m3.gm
    cmrr_db = db(gm1 / max(m5.gds, 1e-12) * gm3 / max(m3.gds, 1e-12) / 10.0) - 4.0
    psrr_db = cmrr_db + 1.0

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "swing": swing,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db}
```
